column8: Thu 19 Nov: 2.2 or the opening of 3b. It maps a relation (literature's ruins all promise first and pay later, with the ruin in the gap) onto the three dated steps that buy before stating (GOLDMINE 27, H1-004), and it names the break: the case's calendar allows the right order. The quotes are read at source and the cross-text reading is Keel's. Never call the two reasons the plan's remaining weak points (NUMBERS 8u, two lists).

Thu 19 Nov: 3e. Fix before use: the gap before January 2028 also holds a deposit cut of more than 73.9% and a 3.57-point fall in yields before January 2027 (NUMBERS 8u), not only a missed deposit; a missed deposit happens before the money is bought, not after; never the two reasons as the ways a promise fails (8u two lists, Q109-033).

Thu 19 Nov: store. The parallel breaks under its own disanalogy (the perils were separate, the joint loss was false news, three argosies came home); IPS l.9 and spine row 2 already carry the correlation; say can, never fall together (Q50).

Thu 19 Nov: 3a and 3f. Nine times covered in value and a month short in time is the relation the ladder answers by buying the date with the sum (IPS l.13); the first plan's one date is NUMBERS 8s. In 3f it is the risk the 27 Sep check priced, never the reason the plan was dropped (CANON A3, IPS l.9).

Thu 19 Nov: 3a or 3f, beside 004. The forgotten Act 5 turns illiquid-not-insolvent (pedigree) into an aha a well-read judge will not have seen. The 8s model has no share return after 2032, so never say the first plan's shares would have recovered.
Thu 19 Nov: store, half a clause in 3a at most: a payment breaks if short or late on its 1 January (8u). Famous line, no new relation.
Thu 19 Nov: store. Pencil in Shylock's words; one conceit, so no turn, and Shylock lends for the forfeit, not the interest.
Thu 19 Nov: twin of row 10 (an unstated figure lowered, never broken); row 10 carries it with 8u's verbs.

Thu 19 Nov: 3a or 3b. A promise to her own residency has no creditor, so the January 2027 purchase is its only enforcer, and the five steps down show erosion in reasonable steps; the break (good reasons are worse than greed) explains IPS l.17's last sentence. Pedigree beside Q7-032 and Q7b-033, not a new precommitment claim.
Thu 19 Nov: 3b. NUMBERS 8u's three verbs in Austen: lowering is honest only while nobody counts on the figure, and Laura lowers only figures nobody has been told.
Thu 19 Nov: store. Colour only: no deposit after 2028 is already the case's fact, and the long-life annuity fear does not apply to ten fixed years.
Thu 19 Nov: store or 3d colour. A framing of Laura as artist and patron; it serves no decision.
Thu 19 Nov: 3b. IPS l.15 (money you already own) is Flavius's warning made into a rule; the break (Timon borrows to give) is recorded; pedigree, one clause.
Thu 19 Nov: the same point as row 13 in two lines; row 13 is the stronger quote.
Thu 19 Nov: store only. A second paper image would compete with pencil and ink; never a turn.

Thu 19 Nov: 3d. I am wealthy in my friends is the sentence IPS l.11 refuses (no payment on anybody else's money); the correlation is already IPS l.9's, so this is a vivid pedigree; say co-sponsors' budgets can fall in the same downturn (Q50).
Thu 19 Nov: store only. Textbook; a flow rule that says nothing about dates or risk.
Thu 19 Nov: writers' background or a 3d reserve only. CONCEIT V2.2 (voice round 7) never names signed beside the definition, so the I.O.U. cannot support 2.0 in the text.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d reserve. An order-of-dates test a co-sponsor could run, and Laura passes it (bottom owned January 2028, top after the 1 January 2031 move, 8r, 8u); the forgery stays out.
Thu 19 Nov: store. Weak link: one account (Table 1) does no job, and Nora's is a hidden loan.
Thu 19 Nov: store. A fraud parallel; row 4 (Antonio) is the honest form of the same risk.
Thu 19 Nov: store or a 3d reserve. A seller gave up ownership for a promise; this adds no decision beyond the order of dates.
Thu 19 Nov: 3e or 2.x. A protected sum's danger is its maker in a panic, and IPS l.17's last sentence is Marie's refusal made into a rule; the break (pique, money hidden from creditors) is recorded.

Thu 19 Nov: 3a. Fix: each payment is its own rung plus the extra Treasuries behind all ten (NUMBERS 8a), never each payment one Treasury; say one named holding per promise, with the late-2032 fund behind three (8w); the one-issuer point stays Q89-001.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d. A pledge with no date and no sum is pencil, and Laura's words give both (the year named every time, voice round 8).
Thu 19 Nov: 3d reserves beside SD-3 (Q150-019): conditional, late and too small is last money. The condition is the co-sponsors', never hers; say held for her, never in her name.
Thu 19 Nov: 2.2 or 3c. A dated plan waited out until the auction, against the move fixed for 1 January 2031 (NUMBERS 8r) before the meetings, not decided at them.
Thu 19 Nov: store. A second voice for pencil, quoted once at most.

Thu 19 Nov: 2.x, the 2028 deposit. Fred finishes a fixed sum by a venture; IPS l.13 finishes the ten from the next deposit before any share is bought; the break (owed debt against her own deposit) is recorded.

Thu 19 Nov: 3f. Fix: the 27 Sep model counted the bad markets (3.2%, 6,453 of 200,000 paths, NUMBERS 8s), so Fred's one-line sum maps to a plan before its check, never to the check; the reason for dropping stays IPS l.9's (CANON A3); never 3.2% fails high.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d. A failed stated figure costs whoever relied on it with earmarked money, which is SD-1's reason (Q150-017) that a figure co-sponsors plan on must be owned.
Thu 19 Nov: store. Only a wording guard (WORDS: certain takes the stated range after the move as its subject), so F 2 at most.
Thu 19 Nov: 3c or 3d. Money promised once cannot back a second promise, which is why the half kept is promised to no one (IPS l.15); the chapter is unconfirmed.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e. The visible failure (a broker) means delay (Q72, Q78), while the cause of ruin is a fixed note against an unowned asset, which none of her promises is; the same shape as Q130-021's trigger and root.
Thu 19 Nov: store. The price of stating before owning, paid by an honest man; never cannot move for a stated figure (NUMBERS 3).

Thu 19 Nov: 3.0 or 2.0. Nietzsche's sorting of necessary from accidental is the plan's sorting (H4-001 already holds it), and the distant as present is a ladder bought six years ahead; pedigree for row 2.

Thu 19 Nov: 3.0 or 3f. It joins IPS l.9 (an income she cannot make calculable) to l.19: her right to promise is bought from the Treasury. The break (will against assets) is named; never said of Laura as a person.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d. One figure, once and late (after the move, before the meetings); the proud tone stays out of Laura's words (voice round 8).
Thu 19 Nov: 3c colour on NUMBERS 8p (the figures match); it describes the Treasuries, never Laura; it adds a quote, not a relation.
Thu 19 Nov: a 3d clause beside Q139-005. Fix: say she offers no collateral, never Laura pledges nothing, since a co-sponsor's office books her figure as a committed pledge (Q147-001).
Thu 19 Nov: store. The bonds carry the plan's discipline, already Q137-018 and Q137-014; colour only.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d. A stated figure is heard by the field's convention (funder test, 16 Nov: they count the top), so her caveats do not travel with it.
Thu 19 Nov: 3c or 3d. Owning the money first leaves only the date in the future; the clash column's guard holds (never identified, Q157).

Thu 19 Nov: 3d, one clause behind SD-3 (Q150-019). Hume's corn is the first mover's uncertainty; the break (Laura hands nothing over before 2033) is named; her flexibility covers a co-sponsor falling short (IPS l.15).
Thu 19 Nov: pedigree for the case's warning (l.114). The penalty deters choosing to break, not being unable to pay, which feeds row 30.
Thu 19 Nov: store only. True of every founder, so it explains no decision of hers.
Thu 19 Nov: writers' background only. Never not a signature beside the definition in 2.0 (CONCEIT: signed is never named there, voice round 7).
Thu 19 Nov: pedigree only. Textbook, and Laura passes it trivially; the translator is not named in the course PDF.
Thu 19 Nov: 3c or 3d. The case's warning is about the honest founder whom Kant's test lets through, and her rule asks for the money, not the belief; the inference is Keel's.

Thu 19 Nov: 3d. Fix: Carnegie Hall's 89 cents is mostly a time discount (9.4% at 4-6%); only 1.6% is the allowance for pledges that fail (Q139-001). Use Q139-005's lender at 80-90 cents for distrust; that an owned figure is rare is not shown.

Thu 19 Nov: 3d or CONCEIT V2.2. Fix: ink as the present tense of a gift breaks on its own disanalogy (no right passes before 2033, she could sell, Q18-027) and pulls ink toward committed (CONCEIT). Say she owns now and gives later: the present tense of owning.
Thu 19 Nov: 2.0 support or 3d. The holdings shown with her figure do the work of Hobbes's other signs besides words; it is a parallel, not his meaning.
Thu 19 Nov: pedigree for the bought deal (H7-067, H6-001): best efforts is Hobbes's endeavour clause, while an owned figure stays the thing itself; say bought deal, never firm commitment (Q152).
Thu 19 Nov: the same point as row 14 (judged possible, not owned); the card itself says it adds nothing.
Thu 19 Nov: Hobbes's first performer is Hume's corn in other words; row 9 carries SD-3's pedigree with the stronger image.
Thu 19 Nov: store. Pledge law is already in the store (H3-109, Q18-028), and credibility as the enforcer is Q7-032.
Thu 19 Nov: the same point as row 7 (said figures carry no private caveat).
Thu 19 Nov: 3c or 3d background. A shrunk share-based top is a later breach (Gamma.2), not a misfire, and ownership, not resolve, closes it; Austin's terms stay out of the prose.

Thu 19 Nov: 3c and 3d, Idea 2's source row. Fix: the only thing left is her choice overclaims, since fund costs past the room under the top (about 2%, NUMBERS 8u) and an early fund end at zero interest (NUMBERS 3) remain; never cannot move.

Thu 19 Nov: 3c and 3d. One sentence to a funder is a forecast and a promise at once, so a wrong forecast becomes a broken promise; it gives certain after the move a reason. The report half is of holdings rounded down, never a fund's payout as fixed (NUMBERS 3).

Thu 19 Nov: 3c and 3d. The usual range protects the promiser (the bottom keeps her word) while co-sponsors count the top; Laura's top is owned and paid (the contribution equals the stated top, 8u), so hers protects the listener; it answers why a range, beside SD-1 and two inkings, two dates.
Thu 19 Nov: 3d. Seneca's pedigree for Q129-010: an owned figure needs no saving clause, so it is said plainly.

Thu 19 Nov: 3d or 3e. IPS l.17 is Seneca's private clause written down and closed at two; the missed deposit is behind her by 2031 (already Q84-040), and the bail line is new; never only two things can break the plan (Q109).
Thu 19 Nov: store. Colour; it does no job.

Thu 19 Nov: 3.0 or 3f. Fix: moves all the risk overclaims, since fund costs beyond the room stay a means risk for each stated figure (NUMBERS 8u); say it takes the market out of the promise. Hobbes partly covers the means, as the row says.
Thu 19 Nov: the conceit use of row 16, with row 16's fix; the slogan (ink is a tense) must not be a kicker.
Thu 19 Nov: unread. Read The Human Condition s.34 in English at source before any use; only a French excerpt was read; say her flexibility, never buffer.
